data.titulo: Chize ha Sanga Lia Meya ndo ha Utuswilo mu Engitu
data.contenido:
Atu nake wika waze anakasala ni mwono ha Sanga lia Meya, alioze hakupalika cha mashimbu atu yaputuka kwoka chinji hano hashi. Hi hakupalika cha miaka 352 muze te Sanga lia Meya hiliapalika kulu mba yikusemuka Apalahama. Yetwe mutulilongesa chize Yehova anakamanuna chilakenyo chenyi ha kuhana kuli Apalahama umwe mwana yoze anavuluka ngwo Izake. Alioze, mukachi ka ana aali a Izake, Zambi yasakula Yakomba.

Yakomba yapwa ni asoko anji, 12 a ana a malunga ni amwe a mapwo. Kumi lia ana ja Yakomba te kakwivwila mwana-kwo Yosefwe kole, kashika yamulanjisa mu undungo ku Engitu. Hakupalika cha mashimbu, Yosefwe yapwa umwe mwanangana mulemu mu Engitu. Muze kwejile zala yinji, Yosefwe yeseka a-yayo hanga aamone nyi te halumuna mbunge jo. Hi kulutwe, asoko eswe a Yakomba, e A-Izalele, yaya ni kutunga mu Engitu. Yuma yino yinakapwa muze te hikwapalika 290 a miaka chize muze Apalahama asemukine.

A-Izalele kanakatunga mu Engitu 215 a miaka. Muze te Yosefwe hafwa, ayo yapwa tupinji mu Engitu. Ha mashimbu jacho, Mose yasemuka, nawa Zambi yamutenga chikwashi hanga alamwine A-Izalele mu Engitu. Mu Chihanda CHAMUCHIALI muli yishima yize yinakalinga 857 a miaka.

YENA unanyingika chuma chitangu chize Noa ni asoko jenyi alingile hakufwambuka mu ulungu? Ayo yahana umwe mulambu kuli Zambi. Yena muhasa kuumona ha chizulie chino chize anauhana. Noa yahana mulambu wa yimuna hanga asakwilile kuli Zambi ha kulamwina asoko jenyi ku sanga linene lia meya.

Kuchi yena wanyonga, shina Yehova kanakazanga mulambu wacho? Ewa, iye kanakauzanga. Kashika iye anakalakenya kuli Noa ngwo kechi keza kanongesa nawa hashi ni sanga lia meya.



Ha mashimbu akehe hashi heswe yihoma, nawa Noa ni asoko jenyi yaputuka ni mwono waha haze lia ulungu. Zambi yaawahisa nawa yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yenwe chanutamba kusema ana anji. Hanga nwoke chinji ndo muze hashi heswe muhazala too ni atu.’

Mba hi kulutwe lia matangwa, muze atu te mevwa hakutwala ku sanga linene lia meya, ayo kota te kakwivwa woma unji ngwe muliza nawa kamuchiali. Kashika Zambi yahana chimwe chuma chize te muchipwa ni kweulula atu chilakenyo chenyi ngwo kuchi kapwa nawa sanga lia meya hano hashi. Yena unanyingika chuma chize Zambi anakaha ngwe cheulwiso? Mwe kongolo.

Kongolo kakusoloka chinji mwilu ha kupanguluka cha tangwa muze hikwanoka vula. Kongolo kakwete ulombo wa mutapu weswe upema. Yena hi unamono kama umwe? Yena unamono umwe ha chizulie chino?

Zambi yamba ngwenyi; ‘Yami ngunalakenya nguchi keza kanongesa nawa atu ni tushitu eswe ni sanga lia meya. Ngunase kongolo wami mu malelwa. Muze kongolo masoloka, Yami mungumumona mba mungweuluka chilakenyo chami.’

Ha chino muze yena mumona umwe kongolo yika chatamba kweuluka? Ewa, chilakenyo cha Zambi ngwo kechi keza kanongesa nawa atu ni tushitu hano hashi ni sanga linene lia meya.Uputukilo 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Yihula ya Longeso

TE HIKWAPALIKA miaka yinji. Ana ja Noa te hasema ana anji. Ana jacho nawa ni noo yasema ana akwo. Chocho hashi yihazala too ni atu.

Umwe wa kuli ayo te kakwata-mbuli wa Noa, jina lienyi te Nimorote. Iye te lunga mupi, te kakushaha tushitu ni atu. Nimorote yalipwisa iye mwene mwanangana hanga ayule akwo. Zambi te keshi kuzanga Nimorote. Ha mashimbu jacho atu eswe te kakuhanjika limi limuwika. Nimorote te kakuzanga ngwo atu eswe atunge hamuwika hanga ahase kwaayula. Yena unanyingika yize iye anakalinga? Iye yatuma atu hanga atunge yimwe mbonge ni umwe kaposhi munene. Muhasa kwaamona ha chizulie chino, kanakumu ndopi.

Yehova Zambi kakawahilile ni utungilo wacho. Zambi te kanazange ngwo atu alimwangashane hashi heswe. Alioze ayo yamba ngwo: ‘Tuyenu! Tutungenu yimwe mbonge ni umwe kaposhi musuku songo lienyi likahete ndo mwilu. Hanga tupwe akwa lufuma!’ Atu jacho te kanazange kulilemesa ayo ene, hi Zambi ko.

Kashika, Zambi anakakanjisa atu jacho kutunga kaposhi. Yena unanyingika chize Zambi anakalinga? Susumuku Zambi yalumbanganyisa malimi jo, hohene ayo yaputuka kuhanjika malimi eka ni eka. Hi akwa kutunga te keshi kulivwa umwe ni mukwo. Kashika, jina lia mbonge yacho yilipwa ngwo, Mbapele, hanji Babilonia, linalumbunuka ngwo “Lumbanganyiso.”

Atu jacho yaputuka kuhichika Mbapele. Yizavu ya atu yize te yakuhanjika limi limuwika yiyiya ni kutunga hamuwika sali likwo lia hashi.Uputukilo 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9. Yihula ya Longeso

MUZE sanga lia meya te hiliapalika kulu, amwe atu te katwama ku chimwe chihela anavuluka ngwo Ure. Mbonge yacho yiyipwa ni lufuma munji, te yikwete mazuwo apema. Alioze atu jamo te kakuwayila tuzambi amahuza. Ngwe chizechene apwile ni kulinga mu Mbapele. Atu a mu Ure ni a mu Mbapele ndako jo te jalisa ni ja Noa ni mwanenyi Sheme, mumu Noa ni Sheme te kakulingila Yehova.

Kulutwe lia sanga lia meya kwapalikile 350 a miaka, mba Noa yafwa. Yikupalika miaka yaali wika mba yikusemuka lunga au unamono ha chizulie. Iye te mutu mupema chinji ku meso ja Zambi. Jina lienyi te Apalahama. Iye te katwama ni asoko jenyi mu mbonge ya Ure.

Limwe tangwa Yehova yamba kuli Apalahama ngwenyi: ‘Katuka mu Ure ni kuli asoko je, hanga uye ku chifuchi chize mungukulweza.’ Shina Apalahama kanakononokena kuli Zambi ni kuhichika uhenya weswe wa mu Ure? Ewa, kanakatayiza. Mumu Apalahama matangwa eswe te kakwononokena kuli Zambi, kashika anamunyingika ngwo sepa lia Zambi.

Amwe a kuli asoko ja Apalahama noo kanakaya nenyi chimuwika muze akatukile mu Ure. Tato Tera neye kanakaya nenyi. Nawa ni muhwa wenyi Lote. Nawa ni mukwo-pwo Sara kanakaya nenyi. Yaheta ha chimwe chihela chize anavuluka ngwo Harane, henoho he anakafwila Tera. Ayo te hapwa kusuku ni Ure.

Ha mashimbu akehe Apalahama ni akwa zuwo lienyi yakatuka mu Harane yaheta mu chifuchi chize anavuluka ngwo Kanana. Kuzekwene Yehova yamwamba ngwenyi: ‘Chino che chifuchi mungukahana kuli ana je.’ Apalahama yatunga muzemwene mu Kanana nawa te kakutwama mu mambalaka.

Zambi yaputuka kukwasa Apalahama, iye yapwa ni mapanga ni yimuna yikwo nawa yinji, ni kama ja ngamba. Alioze, iye ni Sara te keshi mwana niumwe.

Muze Apalahama te hapwa ni 99 a miaka, Yehova yamwamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami ngunakulakenya ngwami, yena mukapwa tata wa mavungu anji.’ Alioze, Apalahama ni Sara te hapwa kulu tushinakaji, kuchi te ayo mahasa kusema mwana?Uputukilo 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA muhasa kumona kama yika yize Apalahama analinga? Kali ni yimwe poko, kota ngwe kanambe kushaha mwanenyi. Mumu liaka iye anambe kulinga chuma chino? Chitangu, tutalenu chize Apalahama ni Sara anakasema mwana wacho.

Euluka ngwo, Zambi kanakaalakenya umwe mwana. Alioze chino chinakapwa chikalu chinji, mumu Apalahama ni Sara te hapwa kulu tushinakaji. Chochene, Apalahama, yafuliela ngwo Zambi mahasa kwalumuna chuma chikalu hanga chipwe chashi. Mba yika yinakapwako?

Muze Zambi alingile chilakenyo chenyi, yikupalika mwaka umuwika. Hohene, muze Apalahama te hapwa ni 100 wa miaka, ni Sara neye te hapwa ni 90 a miaka, mba yijipwa ni umwe mwana wa lunga, jina lienyi te Izake. Chenacho Zambi kanakamanununa chilakenyo chenyi!

Mba muze Izake te hakola, Yehova yeseka ufulielo wa Apalahama. Iye yamusanyika ngwenyi: ‘Apalahama!’ Hi Apalahama yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Ewa, yami uno!’ Mba Zambi yamba ngwenyi: ‘Anda mwane, wa wika Izake, nawa yako kumulundu uze mungukulweza. Hohene mushaha mwane ni kumuhana ngwe chitapo.’

Apalahama kanakevwa chinyengo hakwiva maliji wano, mumu te kakuzanga chinji mwanenyi. Nawa euluka ngwo, Zambi kanakalakenya ngwo ana ja Apalahama makatunga mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Kuchi chino te muchihasa kulingiwa ni Izake mafwa? Apalahama te kaso kunyingika nichimwe, mba chipwe chocho iye yononokena kuli Zambi.

Muze ahetele kumulundu, Apalahama yakasa Izake nawa yamusa ha chilumbilo chize anakatunga. Hohene iye yakwata poko hanga ashahe mwanenyi. Mba hohene mungelo wa Zambi yamusanyika ngwenyi: ‘Apalahama, Apalahama!’ Ni Apalahama yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Ewa, yami uno!’

Zambi yamba ngwenyi: ‘Kanda ulinga upi hali mwana. Haliapwila yami nanyingika ngwami yena uli ni ufulielo unji kuli yami, mumu wanguminyine mwane wa wika.’

Chochene Apalahama kapwile ni ufulielo unji kuli Zambi! Iye te kananyingika ngwo kushi nichimwe chuma chikalu kuli Yehova, nawa ngwo Yehova te mahasa kuhindwisa Izake mu ufwe. Alioze, pundu lume Zambi kakazangile ngwo Apalahama ashahe Izake. Kashika, Zambi yasolola umwe panga yoze te unasakaminya mu mitondo, nawa iye yamba kuli Apalahama hanga ahane panga wacho ngwe chitapo ha chihela cha mwanenyi.Uputukilo 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Yihula ya Longeso

LOTE ni asoko jenyi te katwama hamuwika ni Apalahama mu chifuchi cha Kanana. Limwe tangwa Apalahama yamba kuli Lote ngwenyi: ‘Hano heshi nawa chihela chinene chize muchikumbana ni yimuna yetu yeswe. Ngunaliumbu, tulihandunune. Nyi yena muuya sali ali, yami mungwiya sali likwo.’

Lote yatala kanawa chifuchi chacho. Iye yamona chimwe chihela chipema mu chifuchi muze te muli meya ni yambu yipema ya yimuna yenyi. Chino te chifuchi cha Yordau. Kashika Lote anakayako hamuwika ni asoko jenyi nawa ni yimuna yenyi. Ayo yatunga mu mbonge ya Sondome.

Akwa Sondome te atu api chinji. Yino yinakapinjisa chinji Lote, mumu iye te mutu mupema. Yinakaneha nawa yinyengo kuli Zambi. Hohene, Zambi yatuma angelo aali hanga atoweze Lote ngwo manongesa Sondome ni mbonge ya Ngomora mumu ha mukunda wa upi wo.

Angelo yahanjika ni Lote ngwo: ‘Kawashi! Kwata mukwenu-pwo ni ana je aali a mapwo tuhukenu mu limbo lino!’ Lote ni asoko jenyi te kanalaluka ha kutuhuka, kashika angelo yakwata ku moko jo yaatuhwisa haze lia mbonge. Umwe wa kuli angelo yamba ngwenyi: ‘Chinenu hanga nulamwine mwono wenu! Kanda nutala kunyima ka. Chinyinenu ku milundu, hanga nuchine kufwa.’ Lote ni ana jenyi a mapwo yononoka nawa yachina kusuku ni Sondome. Ayo kakamanyine nawa kakatalile kunyima. Alioze pwo lia Lote yehuka. Muze ayo te haheta ndambu kusuku ni Sondome, iye yamana yatala kunyima. Hohene pwo lia Lote yalumuka chingungu cha mungwa. Yena muhasa kumumona ha chizulie chino?

Yetwe ha chino mutuhasa kulifumba limwe longeso lipema. Yino yinatusolwela ngwo Zambi kakulamwina waze akumwononokena, alioze waze keshi kumwononokena kakutokesa mwono wo.Uputukilo 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luka 17:28-32; 2 Petulu 2:6-8. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA unanyingika mwana-pwo yono uli ha chizulie chino? Jina lienyi Rebeka. Haliapwila lunga yoze unayi ni kulitakana nenyi kali Izake. Iye mapwa mukwo-pwo. Kuchi chino chapwile?

Apalahama tato ya Izake yazanga kufupila mwanenyi umwe pwo mupema. Iye kakazangile hanga Izake ambate umwe pwo wa A-Kanana, mumu akwa Kanana te kakuwayila tuzambi a mahuza. Kashika Apalahama yasanyika ndungo yenyi, yamwamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami ngunazange hanga yena uhiluke kuze kwatwama asoko jami ku Hara, hanga unehe umwe pwo wa mwanami Izake.’

Ndungo wa Apalahama yakwata kumi lia tumelu mba yalinga wenyi usuku chinji. Muze iye ahetele ku chihela chize te kwatwama asoko ja Apalahama, iye yamana kusesa lia shima lia meya. Te hi kwapwa chingoloshi, ha maola waze mapwo a mu mbonge te akwiza ni kutaha meya. Hohene ndungo wa Apalahama yaputuka kulemba kuli Yehova ngwenyi: ‘Linga kama ngwo mwana-pwo yoze mataha meya hanga yami ni tumelu jami tunwe apwe yoze yena hiwatongola kupwa pwo lia Izake.’

Hi ha mashimbu akehe Rebeka yeza ni kutaha meya. Hazehene ndungo yeta meya kuli Rebeka hanga anwe, iye yamwaha. Rebeka yaya nawa ni kuswita meya waze anakumbana hanga tumelu eswe anwe. Te mulimo ukalu mumu tumelu kakunwa meya anji.

Muze Rebeka te hahwisa kuhana meya, ndungo wa Apalahama yamuhula jina lia tato. Iye yahula nawa ni te mahasa kupomba ku zuwo lio. Rebeka yamba ngwenyi; ‘Tata jina lienyi Betuele, nawa ku zuwo lietu kuli chihela hanga yena upombe.’ Ndungo wa Apalahama te kananyingika ngwo Betuele kali mwana wa Nehor mwana-kwo ya Apalahama. Kashika iye yaliumba hashi hanga asakwile kuli Yehova ha kumusongwela kuli asoko ja Apalahama.

Ha ufuku uze wene, ndungo wa Apalahama yalweza kuli Betuele ni kuli Lapane ndumbu wa Rebeka yize yinakamunehako. Ayo eswe yatayiza ngwo Rebeka aye nenyi hanga akalimbate ni Izake. Kuchi Rebeka anakakumbula muze anakamuhula? Iye yakumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Ewa,’ munguya. Kashika, ha tangwa lize linakasuloho ayo yanyina ha tumelu jo yalinga wenyi usuku hanga afune ku Kanana.

Muze ayo ahetele, te hi kwapwa kulu chingoloshi. Rebeka yamona umwe lunga kanende mu wande. Te Izake. Iye yawahilila chinji ha kumona Rebeka. Chize muze afwile Sara, naye ya Izake te hikwapalika miaka yitatu, nihindu iye te uchili ni yinyengo. Alioze, Izake yaputuka kuzanga chinji Rebeka, nawa yawahilila chinjiUputukilo 24:1-67. Yihula ya Longeso

ANA wano aali, kalisa chinji, nyi ngwami? Yena unanyingika majina jo? Chinyanga kali Esau, kanuke yoze unafunga mapanga jina lienyi Yakomba.

Esau ni Yakomba te ana-apasa ja Izake ni Rebeka. Tato Izake, te kakuzanga chinji Esau, mumu te chinyanga mupema nawa te kakuneha kulia kuli asoko jenyi. Alioze Rebeka te kakuzanga chinji Yakomba, mumu te iye kalihumikiza nawa te chimbovu.



Kako Apalahama te uchili ni mwono, kashika yetwe mutuhasa kunyonga chize Yakomba te akuzanga kwivwa Apalahama muze mahanjika hakutwala kuli Yehova. Apalahama kanakafwa ni 175 a miaka, muze ana-apasa te hakumbunyisa miaka 15.

Muze Esau te hapwa ni 40 a miaka yambata mapwo aali a mu chifuchi cha A-Kanana. Chino chinakaneha yinyengo yinji kuli Izake ni Rebeka, mumu mapwo jacho te keshi kuwayila Yehova.

Limwe tangwa yikupwa chimwe chuma chize Esau evwilile chinji uli hali mwana-kwo Yakomba. Yikuheta mashimbu hanga Izake awahise mwanenyi wa mukulwana. Amu te Esau mwe mukulwana wa Yakomba yatwaminyina hanga atambule chiwape chacho. Alioze Esau te hanalanjisa kulu chiteli chenyi cha kutambula chiwape kuli Yakomba. Nawa, muze ayo eswe ni aali asemukine Zambi yamba ngwo Yakomba mwe te matambula chiwape chacho. Chenacho chinakapwa. Izake yahana chiwape kuli mwanenyi Yakomba.

Kulutwe lia matangwa, muze Esau yachinyingika iye yevwila Yakomba uli unji. Yevwa uli unji nawa yamba ngwenyi, mungushaha Yakomba. Muze Rebeka achivwile, iye yalipikala chinji. Kashika iye yamba kuli mukwo-lunga Izake ngwenyi: ‘Muchipwa chipi chinji nyi Yakomba neye mambata umwe mwana-pwo wa A-Kanana.’

Ha chino Izake yasanyika mwanenyi Yakomba yamulweza ngwenyi: ‘Kanda umbata ni umwe pwo wa kuli A-Kanana. Alioze ndo uye ku zuwo lia kakenu Mbetule ku Panda-narame. Ukambateko umwe wa kuli ana ja Lapane.’

Yakomba yapanjika maliji a tato, chocho yalinga wenyi usuku ku Panda-narame, kuze te atunga asoko jenyi.Uputukilo 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; A-Hepreu 12:16, 17. Yihula ya Longeso

UNANYINGIKA atu aka awa anahanjika ni Yakomba? Muze te halinga wenyi wa matangwa anji, Yakomba yaliwana ni atu jacho ha shima lia meya. Te akwa kufunga mapanga. Yakomba yaahula ngwenyi: ‘Kumahenu kuli?’

Ayo yakumbulula ngwo: ‘Ku Harane.’

Yakomba yaahula nawa ngwenyi: ‘Nunanyingika Lapane?’

Ayo yakumbulula ngwo, ‘Ewa, tala mwanenyi wa pwo, Rakele, kaneza ni mapanga.’ Yena muhasa kumona Rakele chize aneza? Muze Yakomba hamona Rakele kaneza ni mapanga ja natu, Lapane, iye yachiza liwe helu lia shima lia meya, hanga mapanga ahase kunwa meya. Hohene, Yakomba yambejala Rakele nawa yamulweza kuze iye anakatuka. Rakele yawahilila chinji, nawa iye yafuna ku zuwo hanga alweze tato Lapane.

Lapane yazanga chinji kutwama ni Yakomba. Kashika muze Yakomba etele Rakele hanga amumbate, Lapane yawahilila chinji. Alioze, Lapane yeta kuli Yakomba hanga akalakale miaka shimbiali mu minda yenyi, mba amwehe Rakele. Yakomba yatayiza, mumu te kakuzanga chinji Rakele. Alioze, muze mashimbu a umbachiso ahetele, yena unanyingika yize yinakapwako?

Lapane yahana kuli Yakomba mwanenyi mutangu, Liya, hi Rakele ko. Muze Yakomba atayijile kukalakalila nawa cheka Lapane ha miaka shimbiali, mba iye yamwaha Rakele hanga apwe mukwo-pwo. Ha mashimbu jacho, Zambi te kakwecha hanga malunga apwe ni mapwo aali chipwe anji. Alioze, musono ka, mumu Mbimbiliya yinasolola ngwo lunga ndo apwe ni pwo umuwika.Uputukilo 29:1-30. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA kama asoko wano anji. Wano kali ana 12 ja Yakomba. Yakomba kali nawa ni ana a mapwo. Yena unanyingika majina ja ana jenyi? Tunyingikenu amwe a kuli ayo.

Liya yasema Rupene, Simeone, Levi, ni Yunda. Muze Rakele amwene ngwo kechi kupwa ni ana, iye yevwa yinyengo yinji. Kashika Rakele yahana ndungo yenyi Mbila kuli Yakomba, mba Mbila yasema ana aali, waze anavuluka ngwo Ndane ni Napatali. Alioze Liya ni neye yahana ndungo yenyi Zelupa kuli Yakomba, Zelupa yasema Ngate ni Ashe. Kulutwe lia matangwa, Liya yasema nawa ana aali, Yisaka ni Zapulone.

Hi mba, Rakele neye yasema umwe mwana. Yamuluka jina ngwo Yosefwe. Kulutwe mutukalilongesa chinji hakutwala kuli Yosefwe, mumu iye kapwile mutu mulemu chinji. Wano kapwile ana 11 a malunga waze Yakomba asemene ni Rakele ni Liya, muze te unachitwama ni Lapane tato ya Rakele.

Yakomba kanakapwa nawa ni ana a mapwo, alioze mu Mbimbiliya muli jina lia mwana wa pwo umuwika. Jina lienyi te Ndina.

Mba yikuheta mashimbu hanga Yakomba akwate chiyulo cha kuhichita Lapane hanga ahiluke ku Kanana. Kashika iye yakunga asoko jenyi ni yimuna yenyi yinji ya mapanga ni ngombe, mba yalinga wenyi.

Muze Yakomba ni asoko jenyi te kanda achiheta ku Kanana, Rakele yasema nawa mwana mukwo. Chino chapwile muze ayo te achili mu wenyi. Kushita chacho chapwile chikalu chinji kuli Rakele, kashika iye anakafwa ha kusema mwana wacho. Alioze mwana wacho yasemuka kanawa. Yakomba yamuluka jina ngwo Mbejamine.

Tweulukenu majina ja ana 12 a Yakomba mumu muli ayo mwe munakeza vungu lia Izalele. Ha chino minyachi 12 ya Izalele yinambate majina 10 a ana ja Yakomba ni majina akwo aali a ana ja Yosefwe. Izake kanakatwama nawa miaka yinji ni mwono muze ana eswe wano asemukine, kota iye kanakevwa chiseke chinji hakupwa ni ajikulu anji. Alioze tutalenu yize yinakapwa kuli mujikulu wenyi Ndina.Uputukilo 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA unamono Ndina aya waze iye anayi ni kumeneka? Iye kanayi ni kumeneka amwe ana-mapwo waze atwama mu chifuchi cha A-Kanana. Shina chino tato Yakomba machizanga? Mba uhase kukumbulula chihula chino, euluka yize te Apalahama ni Izake akunyonga hakutwala kuli ana-mapwo a mu Kanana. Shina Apalahama te kakuzanga ngwo mwanenyi Izake ambate umwe mwana-pwo wa mu Kanana? Ka, iye te keshi kuchizanga. Chikwo nawa, shina Izake ni Rebeka te kakuzanga ngwo mwano Yakomba ambate umwe mwana-pwo wa mu Kanana? Ka, ni ayo te keshi kuchizanga. Yena unanyingika mumu liaka?

Mumu atu a mu Kanana te kakuwayila tuzambi a mahuza. Ayo te hi atu ko apema a kulimbata noo, hanji chipwe kulinga noo usepa. Kashika mutuhasa kupwa ni ushindakenyo ngwo Yakomba te keshi kuwahilila ha usepa uze mwanenyi alingile ni ana-mapwo a mu Kanana.

Ndina yapwa mu kapinda. Yena unamono ha chizulie lunga wa A-Kanana yoze unatale kuli Ndina? Jina lienyi Shekeme. Limwe tangwa muze Ndina ayile ni kwameneka, Shekeme yakwata Ndina yamushinjila hanga alimbombe nenyi. Chino te chipi chinji, mumu waze hanalimbata e mahasa kulipomba wika. Upi uno Shekeme alingile kuli Ndina unakaneha kapinda munji.

Muze mandumbu ja Ndina evwile upi wacho, ayo yevwa uli unji. Aali a kuli ayo, Simeone ni Levi, yevwa uli unji, yanda njangu yaya mu mbonge yatungumuna malunga jacho. Ayo ni mandumbu jo akwo yashaha Shekeme ni malunga eswe akwo. Tato Yakomba yevwva uli unji mumu ana jenyi kanakalinga upi unji.

Kuchi kapinda wacho anakaputuka? Kanakaputuka mumu Ndina kanakalinga usepa ni atu waze te keshi kwononokena shimbi ja Zambi. Yetwe twazangile kupwa ni masepa jacho, nyi ngwami?Uputukilo 34:1-31. Yihula ya Longeso

data.titulo: Yosefwe Yamuvwila Kole Kuli Mandumbu Jenyi
data.contenido:
TALA chize mukweze yono ananyenganyana nawa kanahongo chinji. Kali Yosefwe. Hazehene mandumbu jenyi hamulanjisa kuli malunga waze anayi ku Engitu. Kuze anayi nenyi iye makapwa kapinji. Mumu liaka mandumbu jenyi alinga chuma chino chipi? Mumu te ayo kakwivwila Yosefwe ukwa.

Tato Yakomba te kakuzanga chinji Yosefwe. Yasolola uwahililo wenyi hali iye ha kumulingila chimwe chikuto chipema chinji. Muze 10 lia mandumbu jenyi yamona ngwo Yakomba te kakuzanga chinji Yosefwe, ayo yaputuka kwivwila Yosefwe ukwa ni kole. Alioze kuli nawa chitela chikwo chize te ayo akumuvwila kole.

Yosefwe kapwile ni yilota yaali. Mu yilota yeswe ni yaali mandumbu jenyi yaliumba kuli iye. Muze alwezele yilota yacho kuli mandumbu jenyi, ayo yamuvwila kole yinji.

Limwe tangwa, mandumbu ja Yosefwe te kanafungu mapanga ja tato Yakomba, mba Yakomba yatuma Yosefwe hanga aye atale chize ayo te ali. Muze mandumbu ja Yosefwe yamona iye kaneza, amwe yamba ngwo: ‘Tumushahenu!’ Alioze Rupene, mukulwana wa mandumbu eswe yamba ngwenyi: ‘Ka, kanda numushaha!’ Mba ayo yakwata Yosefwe yamusa mu wina uze te ushi ni meya. Hohene ayo yatwama hashi hanga anyonge yize te mamulinga. Ha mashimbu waze ene, yikwiza amwe malunga a ku A-Ishemali. Yunda yamba kuli mandumbu jenyi ngwenyi: ‘Tumulanjisenu kuli A-Ishemali.’ Chenacho che ayo anakalinga. Ayo yalanjisa Yosefwe mu ndando ya 20 a mbongo ja prata. Chino chapwile chipi chinji hamwe ni uhenge!

Yika mandumbu jenyi makamba kuli tato? Ayo yashaha umwe pembe yakwata chikuto chipema cha Yosefwe yachichupika mu manyinga ja pembe wacho. Mba ayo yatwala chikuto chacho kuli tato Yakomba nawa yamba ngwo: ‘Yetwe twawana chikuto chino. Chitale kanawa nyi cha Yosefwe nyi ka.’

Yakomba yamona ngwo chili cha mwanenyi. Iye yakololoka ngwenyi, ‘Kota umwe kashitu wa mu yambu washaha Yosefwe.’ Chenacho che te mandumbu ja Yosefwe anazange hanga tato anyonge. Yakomba kanakapwa ni yinyengo yinji. Yalila ha matangwa anji. Alioze Yosefwe te kali ni mwono. Tutalenu yika yinakapwa kuli iye kuze anakamutwala.Uputukilo 37:1-35. Yihula ya Longeso

data.titulo: Yosefwe Yamusa mu Zuwo Lia Ususu
data.contenido:
YOSEFWE te uchili wika ni miaka 17 muze ayile nenyi mu Engitu. Kuzekwene yamulanjisa kuli umwe lunga jina lienyi te Potifwa. Potifwa te kakukalakalila mwanangana wa mu Engitu, yoze anavuluka ngwo Falau.

Yosefwe te kakukalakalila chinji mwene wene, Potifwa. Kashika muze Yosefwe te hakola, Potifwa yamusa ngwe kalayi wa yuma yeswe ku zuwo lienyi. Mba, mumu liaka Yosefwe ali mu zuwo lia ususu? Ha mukunda wa pwo lia Potifwa.

Yosefwe yapwa umwe lunga mupema ku mujimba ni ku meso, kashika pwo lia Potifwa yamuzanga hanga alipombe nenyi. Yosefwe te kananyingika ngwo chino chili chuma chipi chinji, kashika iye kakachilingile. Pwo lia Potifwa yevwa uli unji. Kashika muze mukwo-lunga ahetele ku zuwo, iye yalionga ngwenyi: ‘Yosefwe mutu mupi kamba kulipomba ni yami.’ Potifwa yatayiza mahuza jacho nawa yevwila Yosefwe uli unji. Kashika iye yasa Yosefwe mu zuwo lia ususu.

Kalayi yoze te wakufunga zuwo lia ususu yamona ngwo Yosefwe kumana te mutu mupema. Kashika iye yamusa ngwe kalayi wa funge eswe. Kulutwe lia yino yuma, Falau yevwila uli mukwa kumwaha musenge ni mukwa kumulingila mbolo, kashika yaasa mu zuwo lia ususu. Ha umwe ufuku, ayo eswe aali yapwa ni yimwe yilota, mba alioze te kaso kunyingika ulumbunwiso wa yilota yacho. Ha tangwa lize linakasuloho, Yosefwe yamba ngwenyi: ‘Ngulwezenu yilota yenu.’ Muze ayo hamulweza yilota yacho, Yosefwe, ni ukwaso wa Zambi yahana ulumbunwiso wa yilota yo.

Yosefwe yamba kuli mukwa kuhana musenge ngwenyi: ‘Ha kupalika cha matangwa atatu, yena makakuchiza mu zuwo lia ususu, mukapwa nawa mukwa kuhana musenge kuli Falau.’ Yosefwe yamba nawa ngwenyi: ‘Muze yena mutuhuka muno, ulweza kuli Falau hakutwala kuli yami, nawa ungukwasa kama hanga ngutuhuke mu chihela chino.’ Alioze kuli mukwa kulinga mbolo, Yosefwe yamba ngwenyi: ‘Ha kupalika cha matangwa atatu, Falau makakuteta mutwe.’

Ha kupalika cha matangwa atatu, yichipwa chochene ni kulita ni chize Yosefwe ambile. Falau yateta mutwe wa mukwa kumulingila mbolo. Alioze kuli mukwa kumwaha musenge, yamuchiza mu zuwo lia ususu yaputuka nawa kulingila mwanangana. Mba alioze iye yavulama Yosefwe! Iye kakalwezele kuli Falau hakutwala kuli Yosefwe, chocho iye yanunga mu zuwo lia ususu.Uputukilo 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Yihula ya Longeso

YIKUPALIKA miaka yaali, nihindu Yosefwe te uchili mu zuwo lia ususu. Mukwa kuhana musenge kuli mwanangana yamuvulama. Alioze ha umwe ufuku Falau yapwa ni yimwe yilota yilemu yaali, nawa iye yazanga kunyingika ulumbunwiso wa yilota yacho. Unamono chize iye anapombo? Ha chimene, Falau yasanyika malunga jenyi akwa mana yaalweza yuma yize iye alotele. Mba alioze ayo kakahashile kuhana ulumbunwiso wa yilota yenyi.

Hohene hi mukwa kuhana musenge mba yeuluka kama Yosefwe. Iye yamba kuli Falau ngwenyi: ‘Muze yami napwile mu zuwo lia ususu mwapwile umwe lunga te wakuhasa kulumbununa yilota.’ Falau yatuma kawashi kusaka Yosefwe ku zuwo lia ususu. Falau yalweza yilota yenyi kuli Yosefwe ngwenyi: ‘Yami yingumona ngombe shimbiali atohwa nawa apema. Mba yingumona nawa ngombe shimbiali awangama nawa api a yifwaha-yifwaha. Mba ngombe waze te awangama yalia waze te atohwa.

‘Mu chilota chamuchiali, Yami yingumona mieho shimbiali yinene yipema yili ku chishachi chimuwika. Nawa yingumona mieho shimbiali yalela, yahuhuka. Alioze mieho yacho yalela nawa yahuhuka yiputuka kulia mieho yipema.’ Yosefwe yamba kuli Falau ngwenyi: ‘Yilota yeswe ni yaali yili ni ulumbunwiso umuwika. Ngombe shimbiali atohwa ni mieho shimbiali yinene yinalumbunuka miaka shimbiali, nawa ngombe shimbiali awangama ni mieho shimbiali yahuhuka yinalumbunuka miaka yikwo shimbiali. Mukukapwa miaka shimbiali ya kulia chinji mu Engitu. Mba hi mukukapwa nawa miaka shimbiali ya kutepuluka cha kulia.’

Kashika Yosefwe yamba kuli Falau ngwenyi: ‘Sakula umwe lunga wa mana hanga akunge kulia ha miaka shimbiali yipema. Chocho atu kechi kafwa ni zala ha kwiza cha miaka shimbiali yipi muze kulia muchikatepuluka.’

Falau yazanga shimbi yacho. Iye yasakula Yosefwe hanga akunge kulia ni kuchitulika. Mutu mulemu chinji mu Engitu te Falau, wamuchiali yapwa Yosefwe, lunga wa lufuma munji.

Ha kupalika cha miaka nake, ha mashimbu a zala, Yosefwe yamona amwe malunga kaneza. Yena unanyingika aya? Ayo kali 10 lia mandumbu ja Yosefwe! Tato Yakomba mwe unakaatuma mu Engitu, mumu kulia mu Kanana te hichahwamo. Yosefwe yeuluka mandumbu jenyi, alioze ayo kakamweulukile. Yena unanyingika mumu liaka? Mumu Yosefwe te hapwa mukulwana, nawa kuzala chenyi te hichapwa cheka.

Yosefwe yeuluka ngwo, muze iye te uchili mukweze kanakalota mandumbu jenyi kanaliumbu hashi kuli iye. Yena uneuluka yuma yacho? Kashika Yosefwe yanyingika ngwo kumana Zambi mwe wamutumine mu Engitu, ha chimwe chitela chipema. Kuchi yena wanyonga, yika Yosefwe anakalinga? Tutalenu.Uputukilo 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Yihula ya Longeso

YOSEFWE te kanazange kunyingika nyi 10 lia mandumbu jenyi a makulwana nihindu achili akalu hanji api. Kashika iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yenwe nuli ngendeshi. Yenwe nuneza nikutala ulelu wa chifuchi chetu.’

Ayo yakumbulula ngwo, ‘Ka, hi tuli ngendeshi ko. Yetwe tuli malunga angunu. Yetwe eswe tuli mandumbu. Yetwe twapwile 12. Alioze ndumbu mukwo katwamineko nawa, haliapwila wa kanuke kasala ni tata ku zuwo.’

Yosefwe yapwa ngwe te kasokutayiza. Iye yasa ndumbwenyi Simeone mu zuwo lia ususu, nawa yecha akwo hanga atwale kulia ku zuwo lio. Alioze iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Muze yenwe munukafuna kuno ndo nukeze ni mwana-kwenu wa kanuke.’

Muze mandumbu jenyi afunyine ku zuwo lio ku Kanana, ayo yalumbununa kuli tato Yakomba yuma yeswe yize yapwile ko. Yakomba yevwa yinyengo yinji. Iye yalinyenga ngwenyi, ‘Yosefwe katwamineko, haliapwila ni Simeone neye keshiko. Chichi kwecha hanga numbate mwanami wa kasulasongo Mbenjamine.’ Alioze muze kulia yichihwa, Yakomba yecha Mbenjamine aye nenyi mu Engitu hanga anehe kulia.

Yosefwe yamona mandumbu jenyi kaneza. Iye yevwa chiseke chinji ha kumona mwana-kwo Mbenjamine. Mba alioze, niumwe wa kuli ayo te unanyingika ngwo lunga au mulemu te Yosefwe wakwihi. Yosefwe yalinga chimwe chuma hanga eseke 10 lia mandumbu jenyi.

Iye yatuma tuvumbi twenyi hanga azalise njeke jo ni kulia. Alioze kutenga iye yatuma nawa kusa umwe musenge wenyi upema wa prata mu njeke ya Mbenjamine. Muze ayo eswe te haya, nawa te hapwa kusuku mu jila, Yosefwe yatuma tuvumbi twenyi hanga aakaule mu nyima lio. Muze haawana, tuvumbi yamba ngwo: ‘Mumu liaka yenwe nweya musenge wa prata wa mwata wetu?’

Ayo yakumbulula ngwo, ‘Yetwe kutweyile musenge wa mwata wenu. Nyi nwawana musenge mu njeke ya umwe wa kuli yetwe, munuhasa kumushaha.’

Tuvumbi a Yosefwe yafupa mu njeke jeswe, hi ayo mba yawana musenge mu njeke ya Mbenjamine, ngwe chize unamona ha chizulie chino. Tuvumbi yamba ngwo: ‘Yenwe eswe munuhasa kuya, alioze Mbanjamine chatamba kufuna ni yetwe.’ Mba yika 10 lia mandumbu malinga haliapwila?

Ayo eswe yafuna ni Mbejamine ku zuwo lia Yosefwe. Yosefwe yamba kuli mandumbu jenyi ngwenyi: ‘Yenwe eswe munuhasa kuya kwenu ku zuwo, alioze Mbenjamine ndo asale kuno ngwe kapinji kami.’

Hohene Yunda yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami nyi nafunyine ku zuwo ni mukweze yono, tata kumafwa mumu iye kakumuzanga chinji. Ngunaliumbu chinji kuli yenwe, echenu yami hanga ngupwe kapinji kenu, alioze echenu mukweze afune kama ku zuwo.’

Yosefwe yahasa kumona ngwo mandumbu jenyi te hanalumuka. Ayo kumana te haneche upi ni ukalu. Tukaulenu yize iye malinga haliapwila.Uputukilo 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Yihula ya Longeso

YOSEFWE kahashile nawa kulihumikiza mu mbunge yenyi. Iye yamba kuli tuvumbi twenyi eswe hanga atuhuke mu zuwo. Muze iye hasala wika ni mandumbu jenyi, Yosefwe yaputuka kulila. Yetwe mutuhasa kushinginyeka kukomoka cha mandumbu jenyi, mumu ayo te kaso kunyingika mumu liaka iye te analilila. Kusongo iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami nguli Yosefwe. Tata ni haliapwila uchili ni mwono?’

Mandumbu jenyi yakomoka chinji, kakahashile kuhanjika nichimwe. Ayo yevwa woma. Mba Yosefwe yamba ngwenyi: ‘Lisesa tweyenu kuno.’ Muze ayo hakundama, yaalweza ngwenyi: ‘Yami nguli ndumbwenu Yosefwe, yoze yenwe nwalanjishile mu Engitu.’

Yosefwe yanunga ni kuhanjika noo ni umbovu weswe ngwenyi: ‘Kanda nulilamikiza yenwene mumu ha kungulanjisa. Chamwenemwene Zambi unakangutuma mu Engitu hanga ngulamwine mwono wa atu. Falau hanangusa mwanangana wa chifuchi cheswe. Kashika funenu kawashi kuli tata hanga numulumbunwine yuma yino yeswe. Nawa munumulweza hanga eze ni kutwama kuno.’

Yosefwe yakwata mandumbu jenyi eswe nawa yaambejala. Muze Falau hevwa ngwo mandumbu ja Yosefwe haheta, yamba kuli Yosefwe ngwenyi: ‘Anda matemba hanga uye ni kusaka tatenu ni asoko je wize no kuno. Yami mungwaaha chihela chipema cha mu Engitu.’

Yino ye ayo alingile. Hano yena muhasa kumona chize Yosefwe analitakana ni tato muze iye heza mu Engitu ni asoko jenyi eswe. Asoko ja Yakomba yakola yapwa anji. Waze anakaya mu Engitu kanakapwa 70 kuchinga Yakomba ni ana jenyi nawa ni ajikulu jenyi. Mba hapwile nawa mapwo ni tuvumbi anji. Chino che kutwama cho mu Engitu. Te kakwavuluka ngwo A-Izalele, mumu Zambi te hanalumuna jina lia Yakomba yamuluka jina ngwo Izalele. A-Izalele yapwa atu apema chinji kumeso ja Zambi, ngwe chize mutukamona kulutwe.Uputukilo 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Yihula ya Longeso

YENA uli ni keke hali lunga yono unayiza? Jina lienyi Yombi, nawa pwo yono kali mukwo-pwo. Unanyingika yize iye anambe kuli Yombi? Kanambe ngwo: ‘Tuka Zambi hanga ufwe kwe.’ Tutalenu mumu liaka iye anambe chocho, nawa mumu liaka Yombi anamono chize lamba.

Yombi te mutu mukwa ufulielo iye te kakwononokena Yehova. Iye te katwama mu chifuchi cha Uze hakamwihi ni Kanana. Yehova te kakuzanga chinji Yombi, mba alioze te kuli umwe yoze te wakumuvwila kole. Yena unanyingika iya?

Te Satana Ndiapu. Euluka ngwo Satana kali mungelo mupi yoze wakuvwila Yehova kole. Iye mwe unakapiangula Alama ni Eva hanga ehuke kuli Yehova, nawa iye kakunyonga ngwo mahasa kupiangula atu akwo hanga eche kwononokena kuli Yehova. Shina iye kakuhasa kuchilinga? Ka. Achinyonga hali malunga ni mapwo a ufulielo waze hi twalilongesa kulu. Angahi waze yena muhasa kunyingika majina jo?

Muze Yakomba ni Yosefwe te hafwa kulu mu Engitu, Yombi te mutu mukwa ufulielo unji kuli Yehova hashi heswe. Yehova te kanazange hanga Satana anyingike ngwo iye kechi kuhasa kupwisa atu eswe api, kashika iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Tala Yombi. Tala chize ali ni ufulielo kuli yami.’

Satana yakumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Iye kali mukwa ufulielo, mumu yena hi wamuwahisa nawa iye kali ni yuma yinji yipema. Alioze nyi yena wamuchiza yuma yeswe, iye makutuka.’

Yehova yamba ngwenyi: ‘Chilinge. Muchize yuma yeswe. Linga yuma yipi yeswe yize yena unazange hali Yombi. Mututala nyi iye mangutuka. Mba alioze kanda umushaha.’ Chitangu, Satana yatuma atu hanga eye ngombe ni tumelu ja Yombi, nawa ni mapanga jenyi noo yaashaha. Nawa yamushaha 10 lia ana amalunga ni amapwo ha ola yimuwika. Kulutwe lia yuma yacho, Satana yahana kuli Yombi yikola yino yipi. Yombi yamona lamba linji. Kashika mukwo-pwo anakamba ngwenyi: ‘Tuka Zambi hanga ufwe kwe.’ Mba alioze Yombi yalituna kuchilinga. Yikwiza nawa masepa amahuza atatu, yamwamba ngwo iye kanakapwa ni kulinga yuma yipi. Alioze Yombi kanakanunga mu ufulielo.

Chino chinakaneha chiseke kuli Yehova, kashika kulutwe iye yawahisa Yombi, ngwe chize muhasa kumona ha chizulie chino. Iye yamuchiza yikola yeswe. Yombi yasema nawa ana 10 apema chinji, nawa yapwa ni ngombe, mapanga ni tumelu anji chinji kuhianyisa atangu.

Shina yena mununga ni kufuliela kuli Yehova ngwe Yombi? Nyi wachilinga, ni yena Zambi makakuwahisa. Yena mukahasa kutwama ni mwono wa miaka yeswe, muze hashi muhakapwa hapema ngwe munda wa Endene.Yombi 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Yihula ya Longeso

data.titulo: Umwe Mwanangana Mupi Kanayula mu Engitu
data.contenido:
MALUNGA wano unamono hano kanashinjila atu hanga alingi mulimo kutachi. Tala auze unalamba umwe mukwa mulimo! Akwa milimo kali asoko ja Yakomba, waze anavuluka ngwo A-Izalele. Waze anaashinjila ku milimo ya kutachi kali A-Engitu. A-Izalele halumuka tupinji ja A-Engitu. Kuchi chino chinakapwa?

Ha miaka yinji, asoko ja Yakomba kanakatwama ni sambukila mu Engitu. Yosefwe, yoze unakapwa lunga mulemu kunyima lia mwanangana Falau, mwe unakapwa ni kwaafunga. Alioze Yosefwe yafwa. Nawa ni Falau mwaha yoze unakahinga wata mu Engitu, te keshi kuzanga A-Izalele.

Falau yono te mupi chinji, kashika iye yatenga A-Izalele tupinji two. Nawa iye Yaasela tupatashi api nawa a uswiyi. Ayo yashinjila A-Izalele ku milimo ya kutachi hanga atungile Falau mambonge. Alioze A-Izalele yapwa anji chinji ha kwaalula cho. Kashika, A-Engitu yapwa ni woma unji ngwo nyi A-Izalele mooka chinji, ayo mapwa ni tachi jinji. Yena unanyingika yize Falau anakalinga? Iye yahanjika ni yifunguji waze apwile ni kufungula mapwo A-Izalele, ngwenyi: ‘Yenwe ndo nushahe ana a malunga eswe waze anasemuka.’ Alioze mapwo jacho kanakapwa apema chinji kakashahile ni umwe mwana.

Ha chino, Falau yatuma atu jenyi eswe ngwenyi: ‘Andenu ana a malunga eswe A-Izalele hanga nwashehe. Ana a mapwo mahasa kusala ni mwono.’ Chino chili chipi chinji, nyi ngwami? Tutalenu chize umwe mwana wa lunga anakamulamwina.Kutuhuka 1:6-22. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA mwana-kemba kanalila, nawa kanakwata ku munwe wa mwana-pwo. Jina Iienyi Mose. Yena unanyingika mwana-pwo au mupema chize? Iye kali mwana wa mwata wa mu A-Engitu, mwana wa pwo wa Falau.

Naye ya Mose yasweka Mose ndo muze iye akumbanyishine tukweji atatu, mumu iye kakazangile ngwo A-Engitu amushehe. Alioze iye te kananyingika ngwo Mose mahasa kumuwana, kashika iye anakalinga chimwe chuma hanga amulamwine.

Iye yanda umwe mutonga yaululieka kanawa hanga uchine kunjila meya. Mwenamo iye anakasa Mose, nawa yasa mutonga wacho ha yambu yisuku-yisuku ya mu Lwiji Nilu. Ndumbu ya Mose wa pwo, Miriame, yaswama hakamwihi hanga atale yize te muyipwa ko. Mwana wa pwo wa Falau yapalumuka ku Lwiji Nilu hanga asane meya. Hohene iye yamona mutonga ha yambu. Yasanyika umwe kavumbi kenyi wa pwo yamwamba ngwenyi: ‘Yako hanga ungwanjile mutonga auze.’ Muze mwana wa mwata yafukula mutonga, yawanamo umwe mwana mupema! Mwana kemba Mose te kanalila, nawa mwana wa mwata yamuvwila keke yinji. Iye kakazangile ngwo Mose afwe.

Hohene Miriame yasoloka. Yena muhasa kumumona ha chizulie chino. Miriame yahula mwana wa pwo wa Falau ngwenyi: ‘Unazange hanga yami nguye ngukufupile umwe pwo Ka-Izalele hanga akulelele mwana?’

Mwana wa mwata yamba ngwenyi: ‘Mba ngunazange.’

Mba Miriame yazomboka fuji jinji hanga alweze naye. Muze naye ya Mose yaheta, mwana wa mwata yamba ngwenyi: ‘Mbata mwana au ungulelele yo, nawa Yami mungupwa ni kukufweta.’

Chocho naye ya Mose yalela mwanenyi. Muze Mose te hakola ndambu, yamutwala kuli mwana wa pwo wa Falau hanga amulele ngwe mwanenyi. Chenacho che chinakapwa mba Mose yakolela ku zuwo lia Falau.Kutuhuka 2:1-10. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA chize Mose anatuhuka fuji mu Engitu. Yena unamono amwe malunga anamukaula fuji munyima lienyi? Yena unanyingika mumu liaka ayo anambe kushaha Mose? Tutalenu nyi mutuhasa kunyingika mumu liaka.

Mose kanakakolela ku zuwo lia Falau, mwanangana wa mu Engitu. Iye yapwa lunga munene nawa yapwa ni mana anji. Mose te kananyingika ngwo iye hi Ka-Engitu ko, alioze iye te kananyingika ngwo atato A-Izalele te tupinji.

Limwe tangwa, muze iye te hakumbanyisa 40 a miaka, Mose yanyonga kuya ni kutala asoko jenyi chize anapu. A-Izalele kanakapwa ni kwaamwesa lamba linji. Iye yamona umwe Ka-Engitu te kanalamba umwe kapinji Ka-Izalele. Mose yatala sali ni sali, muze iye kamwene niumwe mutu, yalamba Ka-Engitu, yamushaha. Hohene Mose yavumbika mufu wacho mu mavu.

Tangwa likwo, Mose yaya nawa ni kumeneka asoko jenyi. Iye yanyonga ngwo hanji mahasa te kwakwasa, hanga achine kupwa mu upinji. Mba iye yamona amwe malunga aali A-Izalele te kanalilamba, alioze Mose yamba kuli yoze te uli mu uhenge ngwenyi: ‘Mumu liaka yena unalamba usoko we?’

Lunga wacho yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yena, iya kevwe wakusa mwata ni ngaji mukachi lia yetwe? Unambe kungushaha ngwe chize unakashaha Ka-Engitu nyi?’

Mose yevwa woma. Iye yamona ngwo atu hanyingika kulu yize ngunakalinga kuli Ka-Engitu. Chipwe Falau yachinyingika, kashika iye yatuma atu hanga ashehe Mose. Ha chino, Mose yatuhuka mu Engitu yachina.

Muze Mose atuhukile mu Engitu, iye yaya kusuku mu chifuchi cha A-Mindiane. Kuzekwene iye yanyingika asoko ja Yetoru, nawa yalimbata ni umwe mwanenyi jina lienyi Zepora. Mose yapwa kafunga wa mapanga nawa yafunga mapanga ja Yetoru. Iye yalinga 40 a miaka mu chifuchi cha A-Mindiane. Iye yapwa ni miaka 80. Limwe tangwa, muze te Mose anatembula mapanga ja Yetoru, yikupwa chimwe chuma, chize chinakalumuna mwono weswe wa Mose. Fukula lifwo hanga umone yize yinakapwako.Kutuhuka 2:11-25; Yilinga 7:22-29. Yihula ya Longeso

MOSE yaya ndo ku mulundu wa Horepe, hanga awane yambu yipema yakulisa mapanga jenyi. Kuzekwene iye yamona chimwe chiputa chinakwata kahia, alioze te chiso kuwema!

Hohene Mose yanyonga ngwenyi, ‘Chino chikomokeso. Manguchiheteko hanga nguchitale kanawa.’ Muze hakundamako, muchiputa yimutuhuka limwe liji, yiliamba ngwo: ‘Kanda ukundama kuno. Zula sandalia je ku molu, mumu ha mavu unamana kali asandu.’ Zambi mwe watumine mungelo hanga ahanjike nenyi; kashika Mose yalifuka ku meso jenyi.

Zambi yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami ngunamono luyinda wa atu jami ali mu Engitu. Kashika yami mungwapulwila, ngunakutumu hanga ufwambwise atu jami mu Engitu. Yehova te kanazange kutwala atu jenyi mu chifuchi chipema cha Kanana.

Alioze Mose yamba ngwenyi: ‘Yami chichi kuchihasa. Kuchi munguhasa kuchilinga? Alioze nyi naya. A-Izalele mamba kuli yami ngwo: “Iya wakutuma?” Yika mungwamba?

Zambi yamukumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Yino ye yena mukamba.’ “‘YEHOVA, Zambi ya Apalahama, Zambi ya Izake, Zambi ya Yakomba mwe wangutuma kuli yenwe.”’ Yehova yaweza nawa ngwenyi: ‘Lino lie jina liami ndo ku miaka ya mutolo.’

Mose yakumbulula ngwenyi, ‘Nyi ngwe ayo kangutayijile ngwo yena mwe wangutuma.’

Zambi yamuhula ngwenyi: ‘Ai yika unakwata ku kwoko lie?

Mose yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Mukombo.’

Zambi yamba ngwenyi: ‘Umbile hashi.’ Muze haumbila, mukombo yiwalumuka kapela. Yehova yasolola nawa chikomokeso chikwo kuli Mose. Iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Njisa kwoko lie muchima lia hina.’ Mose yanjisa, muze halituhwisamo, yilitoma too ngwe mbundu! Kwoko yilipwa ngwe lili ni yikola yize akuvuluka ngwo mbumba. Hazehene Yehova yahana kuli Mose ndundo hanga alinge chikomokeso chikwo chamuchitatu. Mba iye yamba ngwenyi: ‘Muze yena mulinga yikomokeso yeswe ai, A-Izalele makatayiza ngwo Yami mwe nakutuma.’

Mba Mose yaya ku zuwo yalweza Yetoru ngwenyi: ‘Lisesa ngweche kama nguhiluke kuli akwetu mu Engitu ngwatale chize ali.’ Hi iye yalishika ni Yetoru, mba Mose yafuna ku Engitu.Kutuhuka 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Yihula ya Longeso

data.titulo: Mose ni Arone Yaya Kuli Falau
data.contenido:
MUZE Mose ahilukile ku Engitu, iye yalweza kuli ndumbwenyi Arone hakutwala ku yikomokeso yeswe. Muze Mose ni Arone asolwele yikomokeso yacho kuli A-Izalele, ayo yatayiza ngwo chochene Yehova kali hamwe ni ayo.

Mose ni Arone yaya ni kuhanjika ni Falau. Ayo yamulweza ngwo: ‘Yehova, Zambi ya Izalele, kanambe ngwo, “Echa atu jami aye, ha matangwa atatu, hanga ayo akanguwayile mu puya.”’ Alioze Falau yakumbulula ngwenyi: ‘Yami chanyingikine Yehova. Nawa chichikwecha A-Izalele hanga aye.’

Falau yevwa uli unji, mumu te atu kanazange kuhwima ku milimo hanga aye ni kuwayila Yehova. Kashika, iye yaputuka kwawezela milimo yikalu. A-Izalele yalamikiza Mose ha kapinjiso wacho, Mose yanyenganyana. Alioze, Yehova yamwamba ngwenyi, kanda ulipikala. Nawa Yehova yamba ngwenyi, ‘Yami mungushinjila Falau hanga eche atu jami aye.’ Mose ni Arone yaya ni kuhanjika nawa ni Falau. Ha tangwa liacho ayo yalinga chimwe chikomokeso. Arone yakonga mukombo wenyi hashi, yiwalumuka kapela munene. Mba alioze akwa mana ja Falau noo yachilinga. Alioze, tala! Kapela wa Arone yaputuka kumina tupela ja akwa mana a Falau. Chipwe chocho Falau kechele A-Izalele hanga aye kwo.

Yikwiza amwe mashimbu hanga Yehova ahane limwe longeso kuli Falau. Unanyingika chize iye anakalinga? Iye yatuma luyinda 10, hanji lamba mu Engitu.

Muze lamba hilioka, Falau yasanyika Mose yamwamba ngwenyi: ‘Chiza lamba, mba Yami ngweche Izalele hanga aye kwo.’ Alioze muze lamba te hiliahwa, Falau yanyonga cheka. Iye yalituna kwecha atu hanga aye kwo. Mba hi hakusula, kulutwe lia lamba liamuchikumi (10), mba Falau yatusula A-Izalele hanga aye kwo.

Yena unanyingika 10 lia lamba liacho? Fukula lifwo hanga tulilongese hakutwala ku luyinda wacho.Kutuhuka 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA ha yizulie. Yizulie yeswe yinasolola limwe lamba lize Yehova anakatuma mu Engitu. Ha chizulie chitangu yena muhasa kumona chize Arone analambe mukombo mu Lwiji Nilu. Muze iye anakalinga chocho, meya eswe a mu lwiji yalumuka manyinga. Yishi eswe yafwa, lwiji yaputuka kunuka vumba lipi. Lamba liamuchiali, Yehova yakandwisa mbwota a mu Lwiji Nilu. Ayo yanjila mu mbonge yaputuka kupihisa yuma yeswe—fornu, ndoho ja mbolo, nawa ni mihela—yeswe. Muze mbwota eswe hafwa, A-Engitu yaputuka kwalumbieka, yikupwa vumba lipi.

Nawa, Arone yalamba mukombo hashi, fufuta ya mavu yiyalumuka yikefwe. Yikefwe kali amwe tushitu akehe-akehe, kakusumana nawa kakuhumuka. Lamba liamuchitatu mu Engitu te lia yikefwe. Lamba lieswe likwo linakaheta wika kuli A-Engitu, kuli A-Izalele liakaheteleko. Lamba liamuchiwana te jiji anene-anene, waze anakanjila mu mazuwo ja A-Engitu. Lamba liamuchitano linakashaha tushitu anji. Ngombe, ni mapanga, ni pembe ja A-Engitu kanakafwa.

Ha kusulaho, Mose ni Arone yanda uto yaukonga mwilu. Yiuneha mahute kuli atu ni tushitu. Lino lie te lamba liamuchisambano.

Kulutwe lia yino yuma, Mose yolola kwoko lienyi mwilu, nawa Yehova yatuma mihenyo ni chiwe. Chinakapwa chimwe chiwe chipi chinji chize te mu Engitu kanda achichimona kama. Lamba liamuchinake te chizavu chinene cha mapasu. Te nilimwe tangwa kanda kuchipwa kama mapasu wano anji. Ayo yalia yuma yeswe yize chiwe chinakahichika.

Lamba liamuchilivwa te milima. Ha matangwa atatu, chifuchi cheswe yichipwa mu milima pwi, alioze A-Izalele yapwa mu pangu.

Hi kusuloho, Zambi yatuma atu jenyi hanga akwite manyinga a mwana-pembe hanji a mwana-panga helu lia yikolo yo. Mba, mungelo wa Zambi yapalika mu Engitu. Muze mungelo amwene manyinga jacho, kakashahile niumwe wa ku mazuwo jacho. Alioze, ku mazuwo eswe waze te kushi kukwita manyinga helu lia yikolo, mungelo wa Zambi yashaha ko tupula-majimo eswe ja atu ni tushitu. Lino te lie lamba liamuchikumi.

Ha kupalika cha lamba lino lia kasula, Falau yecha A-Izalele hanga aye kwo. Atu ja Zambi te hanalilulieka kulu hanga aye, kashika hakachi ka ufuku uzewene ayo yijituhuka mu Engitu.Kutuhuka kapitulu 7 ndo 12. Yihula ya Longeso

TALA yize yinapuko! Au Mose, kanolola mukombo wenyi helu lia Kalunga-lwiji Muchila. Kali hamuwika ni A-Izalele, haalamwina. Alioze Falau ni maswalale jenyi eswe kanashimbama mu Kalunga-lwiji. Tutalenu kuchi chino chinakapwa.

Twalilongesanga ngwo, Falau yecha A-Izalele hanga aye kwo muze te Zambi hatuma lamba liamuchikumi kuli A-Engitu. A-Izalele kanakatuhukamo mu unji wa 600,000 a malunga, hamwe ni mapwo ni ana. Nawa ni atu akwo anji waze anakafuliela kuli Yehova yaya hamuwika ni A-Izalele. Eswe yambata mapanga jo, ni pembe ni ngombe.

Muze te kanda achiya, A-Izalele yeta kuli A-Engitu mazalo, ni upite wa oru ni wa prata. A-Engitu te woma unji anevu, ha mukunda wa lamba lia kasula lize anakapwa nalio. Ayo yahana kuli A-Izalele yuma yeswe yize ayo anaketa.

Kulutwe lia amwe matangwa, A-Izalele yaheta ku Kalunga-lwiji Muchila. Hazehene ayo yahwima. Alioze, Falau ni atu jenyi yaputuka kwivwa kupihia ku mbunge ha kwecha A-Izalele hanga aye kwo. Ayo yamba ngwo, ‘Twachinyisa tupinji jetu!’

Kashika, Falau yanyonga cheka. Yalulieka kawashi-kawashi mashinyi a jita ni maswalale. Ayo yaputuka kukaula A-Izalele hamuwika ni 600 ja mashinyi a jita, ni mashinyi akwo eswe a mu Engitu.

Muze A-Izalele amwene Falau ni maswalale jenyi, yaputuka kwivwa woma unji. Ayo te kaso kumona kuze machinyina. Kulutwe te Kalunga-lwiji Muchila uliko, kunyima te A-Engitu anezako. Alioze Yehova yasa limwe lelwa hanga lihandunune atu jenyi ni A-Engitu. Kashika, ayo te keshi kuhasa kumona A-Izalele hanga akwate.

Yehova yamba kuli Mose ngwenyi, zundula mukombo we uwolole ha Kalunga-lwiji Muchila. Muze iye alingile chocho, Yehova yaneha chimwe chijimbi chinene cha ku chivumbuko. Meya eswe a mu Kalunga-lwiji yaliteta ha muchima yaakala mbe sali ni sali ngwe yikalakala.

Mba A-Izalele yenda hashi homu mukachi ka Kalunga-lwiji. Kunakapalika maola anji ha kuzauka cha tununu twa atu ni yimuna yo yeswe ha kwalamwina hanga aye sali likwo. Mba, A-Engitu yaamona cheka A-Izalele. Tupinji jo te kanachina! Ayo yanjila mu kalunga-lwiji hanga aakaule.

Muze ayo alingile chocho, Zambi yasepwola malota ja mashinyi jo. A-Engitu yevwa woma unji yaputuka kuteta ngwo: ‘Yehova mwe unakalila A-Izalele. Tufwambukenu muno!’ Alioze mashimbu te hapalika kulu.

Chino chinakapwa muze Yehova anakatuma Mose hanga olole mukombo wenyi ha Kalunga-lwiji Muchila, ngwe chize unamono ha chizulie. Muze Mose anakalinga chino, yikalakala ya meya yiyifuka A-Engitu ni mashinyi jo eswe. Maswalale eswe kanakanjila muchima lia Kalunga-lwiji hakukaula A-Izalele. Kashika niumwe wa kuli A-Engitu wasalile ni mwono wakwihi! Chiseke chinji atu ja Zambi anakapwa nacho ha kwaalamwina! Malunga yemba mwaso wakuhalisa nawo Yehova ngwo: ‘Yehova hanangama ni kukumba cha uhenya. Hanyasa tuvwalu ni akwa kwaendesa mu kalunga-lwiji.’ Miriame, ndumbu ya Mose, yakwata kalialia, ni mapwo eswe yalinga chochene. Yaputuka kukina ni chiseke chinji, noo yemba ngwo: ‘Yehova hanangama ni kukumba cha uhenya. Hanyasa tuvwalu ni akwa kwaendesa mu kalunga-lwiji.’Kutuhuka kapitulu 12 ndo 15. Yihula ya Longeso
